# Landing-page example looks

Four AI-generated fashion photos used in the landing-page "example looks" gallery:

- `woman-summer-dress.jpg` — woman in a summer dress
- `man-smart-casual.jpg` — man in smart-casual outfit
- `boy-kurta.jpg` — boy in a kurta
- `woman-saree.jpg` — woman in a saree

Reference them from the app as `/examples/<name>.jpg` (Vite copies `client/public/` to the build output).
Do not commit anything else in this directory (JSON sidecars, original filenames).
